prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for specific kinds of changes because each category only has 1 test so far.
Predictions were consistently too high across all tests compared to noise-corrected measurements.
The choose_path, hint change was helpful (won with +2.5% after noise correction), though evidence is still thin with only one test.
No clear effect was seen for home, new_flow, adoption, notification, or sign_in, incentive changes.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, notification: -1.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, hint: +2.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, new_flow: -0.9% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, incentive: +1.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.8%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 18.0%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Defer Sign-In Step After Adoption: Move sign-in after pet adoption so users personalize their pet before creating an account. (why: Adoption has a low 60.9% conversion; forcing account creation upfront adds friction before users build emotional attachment.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Controls Interactive Tutorial: Add a new desktop controls guide screen immediately after initial home intro. (why: Support receives frequent confusion emails ([after_onboarding, confusion]) on how to interact with, hide, or control the pet.)
2: [home, new_flow] Interactive Pet Mascot Waiting Flow: Add an interactive pet mascot animation and tip carousel to engage users during background setup. (why: The waiting screen has a long mean duration of 2336s, causing user drop-off during background loading.)
3: [choose_path, copy] Clear Path Selection Benefit Copy: Clarify path options with explicit benefits comparing pre-made pets vs custom pet creation. (why: Choose_path has a high mean duration (514s) indicating confusion when selecting a start path.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Account Persistence Sign-In Hint: Add a prominent hint explaining how signing in saves pet customization securely. (why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing back in.)
5: [adoption, layout] Spotlight Adoption Certificate Layout: Switch adoption certificate view to spotlight layout with full progress display. (why: Adoption drop-off is severe (60.9%), requiring a more celebrated completion screen.)
6: [home, wait_info] Visual Progress Timer on Waiting Screen: Add an explicit progress bar and estimated completion timer to the waiting screen. (why: Waiting step takes median 201s / mean 2336s, leaving users unsure if setup is still running or frozen.)
7: [choose_path, notification] Background Readiness Notification Option: Enable time estimates and desktop ready notifications during initial story intro. (why: High overall mean completion time (5815s) makes upfront time expectations and background alerts necessary.)
